accessDenied.title: Parents' area
accessDenied.description: This area is only visible to adult family profiles.

hero.title: Parent hub
hero.description: Manage profiles, tasks and kids' dashboards in one calm place – without jumping between multiple areas.

modules.title: Family sections
modules.intro: Turn off features your family does not use. They disappear for every profile and can be enabled again here at any time.
modules.profileHint: To customize one person, edit that profile and choose its visible sections.

managed.title: Managed profiles
managed.intro: For grandma, grandpa or people in your care: they appear in events and tasks, but not at sign-in or in the chat.
managed.emptyHint: Choose “Managed by us only” when creating a profile.

children.title: Administer profiles
children.emptyDescription: First create a profile as a child or teenager.

points.title: Reward points
points.intro: Reset the points of children and adults separately. Pets don't collect reward points.

media.title: Media lounge
media.intro: Add approved YouTube channels and Spotify playlists as large, kid-friendly tiles. Only what you approve here is visible.

homeAssistant.intro: Brings selected home states into the family planner as real tiles. The access token stays encrypted on your server.

connect.addressHint: With Docker, using the fixed IP on your home network is most reliable.
connect.tokenPlaceholder: Token from your Home Assistant profile
connect.tokenHint: The token is no longer shown after saving.

toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Search for a device or sensor

callout.title: Choose dashboard tiles
callout.description: Load the devices and decide exactly what may be visible and controllable.

saveBar.hint: Adults see everything, children only what is shared with them.

webPush.introNative: The LX app registers this Android device once for a profile. After that, alerts arrive even when the app is closed.
webPush.introWeb: Each phone or tablet registers once for a family profile. Keys and technical details stay invisible.

serverMissing.title: Firebase connection still missing
serverMissing.description: The LX server doesn't have a private Firebase service key yet. That's why it can't reach Android at the moment.
serverMissing.hint: Store the service key only in the server's data folder, then install the LX app built with the same Firebase project. The key never belongs in the Git repository.

checking.title: Checking the Android connection
checking.description: LX is requesting the current Firebase status from the family server.

statusError.title: Status could not be checked
statusError.fallback: The app hasn't received a response from the family server yet.

unavailable.titleSecureContext: HTTPS is missing – that's why background push isn't working
unavailable.hintNative: Install the latest LX Android app to use native notifications.
unavailable.hintWeb: Open the planner via a trusted HTTPS address, add it to your Android home screen, then activate this device.

denied.title: Turned off in the browser
denied.bodyNative: Allow notifications under Android → Apps → LX Family → Notifications.
denied.bodyWeb: Allow notifications in your browser's site settings and then reopen the planner.

ready.title: Register this device for {{name}}
ready.hintNative: One tap – the Android prompt appears only once.
ready.hintWeb: One click – no token and no extra app.

connectedNote.title: Ready for background push
connectedNote.bodyNative: Android shows family alerts in the system tray and, if you like, on the lock screen – even when LX is closed.
connectedNote.bodyWeb: For the most reliable delivery on Android, install the planner via “Add to Home screen” and allow notifications in the Android app settings.

preview.title: Show details on the lock screen
preview.hint: When turned off, chats, tasks and events stay private.

gotify.title: Gotify notifications
gotify.intro: Important family moments reach you even when the planner isn't open.

security.title: Secure setup
security.body: The password is used only once to create a dedicated Gotify app and is not stored.

includeText.title: Show message text on the lock screen
includeText.hint: Turned off by default for privacy reasons.

gotify.phoneUrlLabel: Open this planner address when tapped

ntfy.title: ntfy notifications
ntfy.intro: Sends the same selected family events to an ntfy topic – self-hosted or via ntfy.sh.

security.title: Treat the topic like a password
security.body: Use a hard-to-guess topic name. An optional access token is stored encrypted.

ntfy.plannerUrl: Open this planner address when tapped
ntfy.includeText: Show message text in the notification
ntfy.includeTextHint: Turned off by default for privacy reasons.

problemReports.title: Problem reports
problemReports.intro: Reports stay on your server. With “Copy” they can be passed on in full and without credentials.

copy.successBody: You can now paste it directly into GitHub or a message.
copy.errorBody: The browser blocked access to the clipboard.

empty.title: No open reports
empty.hint: Everything is quiet here right now.

webdav.title: WebDAV family archive
webdav.subtitle: For NAS and DAV servers without Nextcloud.
webdav.securityNote1: If possible, use a dedicated app password.
webdav.securityNote2: For a NAS on the home network, the following must also be set on the LX server:
webdav.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect WebDAV? The files on the server will be kept.

toasts.connectedBody: Your family archive now uses this WebDAV folder.
toasts.disconnectedBody: The credentials have been removed from LX.
